title: The Frobenius-induced endomorphism of the cotangent complex in characteristic p is null homotopic
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: if p is a prime, A -> B is a ring homomorphism with p = 0 in A, then the map L_{B/A} -> L_{B/A} induced by the Frobenius maps is homotopic to zero (source lines 2017-2023). The proof takes the standard resolution P_bullet of B over A, uses the Frobenius homotopy lemma to see that the induced self-map of P_bullet is homotopic to the termwise Frobenius map, and concludes because the termwise Frobenius induces the zero map on each module of differentials, the derivative of a p-th power being zero.
